input.quote: 14.2 Upon creation and subject to payment of the applicable Fees, Customer owns each Deliverable created specifically for Customer. Vendor hereby assigns to Customer all worldwide right, title, and interest in those Deliverables and shall obtain equivalent assignments from its personnel. Vendor will execute further documents reasonably needed to confirm ownership.
input.rationale: Section 14 meets our preferred position in full. 14.1 confirms Customer owns Customer Data, Customer Confidential Information and Customer pre-existing IP, with no transfer to Vendor beyond a limited processing right (reinforced by 15.1's no-sale/no-model-training restriction). 14.2 vests ownership of Deliverables in Customer on creation with a present assignment from Vendor and personnel-level assignments. 14.3 leaves Vendor Technology with Vendor (acceptable) but applies the Section 13.2 perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to any Vendor Technology embedded in or required to use a Deliverable, including modification and contractor support. 14.4 excludes joint ownership absent a signed instrument and preserves Customer's unrestricted rights in its own feedback. No walk-away triggers (no assignment of Customer IP/Data, no joint ownership, no vendor-owned deliverables without licence back). Minor note only, not a deviation: the 13.2 licence lists contractor support rather than an express sublicensing right, which is immaterial given Customer owns the Deliverables outright.
